title: How Rob Hallam built canivibecoded.com and sold ~$9k/mo of sponsorships in 4 days
summary: Rob replied to a Levels.io tweet with an idea, was challenged to build it, and shipped canivibecoded.com open source overnight. A tweet and video brought 35k views and 9k visitors in 48 hours, and sponsor slots sold at $299 to $999 each, reaching about $7.6k/mo. His next problem is keeping traffic high enough to give sponsors ROI.

principles.text: Act immediately when a public conversation hands you an opening; build and post the same night.
Open sourcing the product can make the idea work better.
principles.quote: أعتقد أنها تعمل بشكل أفضل عندما تكون مفتوحة المصدر.

principles.text: Make it dead simple to use and a little funny.
principles.quote: أعتقد أن الشيء المهم هو أنه سهل الاستخدام حقاً، وأنه مضحك نوعاً ما.

principles.text: Once traffic exists, tiered sponsor slots can monetize a small site within days.
Sponsors need ongoing ROI, so sustaining visitor traffic becomes the core post-launch problem.
principles.quote: لكي أستمر في تقديم عائد على الاستثمار لجميع الرعاة، يجب أن أحافظ على حركة الزوار.

principles.text: A tool people keep returning to has retention that supports sponsor value.
principles.quote: يبدو أن هذا شيء يعود إليه الناس باستمرار
